title: No CycleMin itinerary has p=1 by trailing-evens cells, independently of height finance
statement: Every CycleMin one-peak word w=O^o E^e with e>=4 and 2^{o+e}<3^o is impossible by the trailing-evens cell plus the odd-run envelope or the O7-style +1-chain. This would give a floor-free p>=2 orthogonal to e>=4 and to height/joint-minima finance.
counterexamples: p is the existing circuit count m. On E_run(10^6) (99 lengths), joint-minima and height packing already kill m=1 and m=2 at n=10^6+1, so leftover p>=3 is a Section 4 corollary
The +1-chain that fires (N0=55 at L=19, N0=12492 at L=25781, N0=401 at L=55293) has slack exactly 3^o-2^L, the CycleMin slack identity already named for e=4 as slack_of_four_even
Theorem 4.7 packing achieves p=e, so p<=cL-C with c<0.36907 is false at the itinerary level; o-1 never binds on expanding L>=4
notes: Phase 0 only. p≡m. Target A is packaging. Not a reopen of peak-descent, return-cost, or Section 5. No Lean, no Paper A edit. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: E_run(10^6) 99 leftovers at n=10^6+1 for m=1,2; cell grid 4<=e<=12 with o from o_min through +3; leftover one-peak words L=25781 and L=55293; O^7 EEEE exponent check
